name: Lastras del Pozo (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided red over white within a yellow border, with a white Maltese cross in each corner and the crowned municipal arms of Lastras del Pozo at the centre (a bull on white and the aqueduct on red).
history: The arms and flag of Lastras del Pozo were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 24 June 1998; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, divided red over white, with a yellow bordure cantoned with four white Maltese crosses, and the arms over all.

features.role: Maltese crosses in the corners of the border
Lastras del Pozo arms — bull on white and the aqueduct on red
